shared_elements: shallow relief carving on a rectangular stone surface
figures rendered in strict profile with a prominent frontal-ish eye
incised linear detailing of body/surface texture
repeated rows of small units forming banded patterns
justification: Both are tan stone slabs bearing low relief with profile-oriented subjects and repetitive rows of small incised units (A's band of hatched/toothed motifs, B's beaded rows of hair and beard), which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a crowded multi-register field of schematic, flat-outlined animal forms on an upright monolith in situ, while B is a single large, softly modelled human head with meticulously worked detail filling a discrete framed panel.
